name: Kaii Keijiban to Nanatsu no Uwasa
original_name: 怪異掲示板と7つのウワサ
source:
There was a secret forum managed by the newspaper club at a high school.
The “rumors” posted on the forum become “reality” and even “mysterious”…
What on earth are the “seven mysterious stories” posted on the forum…?

※Please note that there will be some grotesque, bloody and cruel descriptions in some endings.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.entabridge.chatnovel3en]Google Playstore[/url]]
translation:
一所高中的报社有一个秘密论坛。
论坛上的“谣言”变成“现实”甚至“神秘”……
论坛上发布的“七个神秘故事”到底是什么……？

※请注意，部分结局中会有一些怪诞、血腥、残忍的描述。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.entabridge.chatnovel3en]Google Playstore[/url]]
